'''2013 SoCal Grand Prix Day 1 Gabe DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Gabe]] at [[2013 SoCal Grand Prix]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
